description:
## Problem (reproduced on SQLite by an independent reviewer; owner decision needed)
After the notuning reuse gate (`tuning-notuning-db-reuse-gate-20261001`), the guard "a tuned database is still refused for a notuning run" depends on finding tuning metadata. A database that was physically tuned but has no metadata is reused as a baseline: `database_was_reused=True`, no error, no warning. Ways to get there: a tuned run whose metadata save fails (it is non-fatal and prints only a warning), a crash between `apply_unified_tuning` and the save, the external-table path (returns before any metadata is saved), and a config with only constraints or platform optimisations whose section-marker save is swallowed. A narrower variant: a wizard config that sets only `sorted_ingestion_mode` collapses to `tuning_enabled=False` while sorted ingestion still applies the config.
The result: a later notuning run reports tuned performance as the baseline.

## Change (options; the prior item forbade a baseline marker)
- Make a failed or skipped tuned metadata save mark or clean the database, or fail the run.
- Or write an explicit baseline/tuned marker (reverses the earlier "do not write a marker" instruction; needs an ADR line).
- Decide how `infer_runtime_tuning_mode` treats configs that apply tuning without the usual keys.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- A tuned database is refused for a notuning run when metadata exists.
- Baseline databases need no metadata table unless the owner chooses the marker option.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
